{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion turbine''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian's]] [[Talon I combat cloud car]] was powered by an Ion Turbine slung under the body of the craft, surrounded by a [[Intake|cooling intake]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
